# MYRI Medical Billing

> MYRI Medical Billing is a billing company that works only with chiropractic practices. Based in Lake Mary, Florida, it serves chiropractors remotely and works inside the practice's existing EHR (ChiroTouch, Jane App, ECLIPSE, Genesis, ChiroFusion, DrChrono, Tebra/Kareo, and others).

Key facts:
- Specialty: chiropractic billing only.
- Services: claim submission, chiropractic CPT coding (98940-98942), Medicare chiropractic compliance (AT/GA/GZ/GY modifiers, ABNs), denial management and appeals, A/R follow-up, credentialing, personal injury and PIP billing, and patient billing statements.
- How it works: a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement is signed first; the practice adds a separate MYRI user with billing permissions. Practices keep their own software.
- Pricing models: percentage of collected revenue (typically 3.5-5%), a custom bundled monthly plan, or a flat fee per claim.
- Free offer: a free 30-day billing review. Practices can send four standard reports instead of sharing a login.
- Contact: (321) 414-1896, info@myrimedicalbilling.com
